We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: From Dec 2010 to July 2011, defendant Wu Moujia (武某甲) together with others violated land management regulations, without approval, hired people to excavate mountain and quarry stone on east mountain of Baizhuang village, causing large area of forest land destroyed. The destroyed forest area is 12.1 mu (approx 0.81 hectares). This is illegal logging/deforestation. The list includes "滥伐林木" (illegal logging), "盗伐林木" (illegal logging by theft?), "污染环境", "滥伐林木". The case is about illegal excavation causing forest destruction. The appropriate charge likely "滥伐林木". Also maybe "非法占用农用地"? They excavated mountain, but it's forest land, not farmland. The list includes "非法占用农用地" (illegal occupation of agricultural land). Not relevant.

Thus charge: "滥伐林木". Also maybe "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物" but not mentioned as protected. So "滥伐林木" is correct.

Check list: "滥伐林木" is present. So answer: [罪名]滥伐林木<eoa>
